::: {.nv-main}
::: {#todos}
:::
:::

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var f = "todos", q = "", tema = "";
  var caixaTema = document.querySelector(".nv-tema");
  function aplica() {
    var n = 0;
    document.querySelectorAll(".nv-linha").forEach(function (el) {
      var ok = (f === "todos" || el.dataset.area === f) &&
               (!q || el.dataset.busca.indexOf(q) >= 0) &&
               (!tema || el.dataset.cats.split("|").indexOf(tema) >= 0);
      el.hidden = !ok; if (ok) n++;
    });
    document.querySelector(".nv-vazio").hidden = n > 0;
    caixaTema.hidden = !tema;
    if (tema) caixaTema.querySelector("span").textContent = "Tema: " + tema;
  }
  function escolhe(chave) {
    document.querySelectorAll(".nv-aba").forEach(function (x) {
      var on = x.dataset.f === chave; x.classList.toggle("ativa", on); x.setAttribute("aria-selected", on);
    });
    f = chave; aplica();
  }
  document.querySelectorAll(".nv-aba").forEach(function (b) {
    b.addEventListener("click", function () {
      escolhe(b.dataset.f);
      history.replaceState(null, "", b.dataset.f === "todos" ? location.pathname : "#" + b.dataset.f);
    });
  });
  document.getElementById("nv-q").addEventListener("input", function (e) { q = e.target.value.toLowerCase().trim(); aplica(); });
  caixaTema.querySelector("button").addEventListener("click", function () { tema = ""; history.replaceState(null, "", location.pathname); aplica(); });
  function leHash() {
    var h = decodeURIComponent(location.hash.slice(1));
    if (h.indexOf("tema=") === 0) { tema = h.slice(5); escolhe("todos"); }
    else if (document.querySelector('.nv-aba[data-f="' + h + '"]')) { tema = ""; escolhe(h); }
  }
  window.addEventListener("hashchange", leHash);
  leHash();
})();
</script>
```
